notes: Read the complete broadband unit, pandemic-worker context, all eight candidates and the review. Named U.S. state and federal referents while preserving municipal-broadband funding conditions. Restored the reported stay-at-home pandemic premise and the shared home-participation purpose of infrastructure, subsidy and digital-literacy measures.

claims.claim_text: Millions of Americans stayed home to prevent the pandemic's spread.
Democrats would prevent U.S. states from blocking municipalities and rural cooperatives from building publicly owned broadband networks.
Democrats would increase U.S. federal support for municipal broadband, conditioned on recipients supporting good jobs and strong worker-organizing rights.

Public broadband investment, low-income access subsidies and digital-literacy training are intended to let children, families and people with disabilities participate fully in school, work and life from home.
